fullText.simplified:
第9章、厉害的关羽

    天亮了。
    凡城的城门开了，先走出来的是新也人，然后凡城人也走了出来，最后是刘备和他的军队。
    新也人和凡城人都不太相信曹操，他们选择跟刘备一起离开凡城。
    两天后，曹操的军队杀到了。空城，又是空城！
    曹操生气极了，他为不投降的刘备生气，也为新也和凡城人生气！他不让军队休息，让他们一直找刘备。这一次，他一定要杀了刘备。
    几天以后，曹操终于找到了刘备。
    曹操看了刘备和他的军队，也看到了走在军队中间的新也和凡城人。曹操觉得有些好笑，刘备是个聪明人，但爱做不聪明的事。自己都不能保护的人，要怎么保护别人呢？
    “杀！”曹操大声说。
    大战开始了，但是两边的人都不少，而且是在山里，树和草太多，路太小，仗打了很多天。刘备和军队在跑，新也和凡城人也在跑，往山上跑，往河里跑，往树和草里跑……哪儿有路，就往哪儿跑。
    刘备的人越来越少，越来越少。曹操的人离刘备越来越近，越来越近。七天以后，刘备没有路了，张飞和赵云也都累了，每个人都跑不动了。曹操的军队就在后面，大声叫着要来杀刘备。
    就在这时候，路边的树和草里突然冲出来另一队人马，有一万多人。
    最前面的那个人骑着大马，手拿大刀，他对曹操的兵大声说：“我在这儿等你们很久了！过来吧，让我杀了你们！”
    曹操的兵害怕极了，这个人他们都认识，是关羽啊！以前关羽在曹操这儿的时候，大家都见过关羽，也知道关羽有多厉害，谁敢和厉害的关羽打啊？而且现在关羽的后面还有这么多人的军队，就更没有人敢打了。有人开始往后跑，很快，更多人跟着往后跑。不到一会儿，曹操的兵都跑了。
fullText.traditional:
第9章、厲害的關羽

    天亮了。
    凡城的城門開了，先走出來的是新也人，然後凡城人也走了出來，最後是劉備和他的軍隊。
    新也人和凡城人都不太相信曹操，他們選擇跟劉備一起離開凡城。
    兩天後，曹操的軍隊殺到了。空城，又是空城！
    曹操生氣極了，他為不投降的劉備生氣，也為新也和凡城人生氣！他不讓軍隊休息，讓他們一直找劉備。這一次，他一定要殺了劉備。
    幾天以後，曹操終於找到了劉備。
    曹操看了劉備和他的軍隊，也看到了走在軍隊中間的新也和凡城人。曹操覺得有些好笑，劉備是個聰明人，但愛做不聰明的事。自己都不能保護的人，要怎麼保護別人呢？
    “殺！”曹操大聲說。
    大戰開始了，但是兩邊的人都不少，而且是在山裡，樹和草太多，路太小，仗打了很多天。劉備和軍隊在跑，新也和凡城人也在跑，往山上跑，往河裡跑，往樹和草裡跑……哪兒有路，就往哪兒跑。
    劉備的人越來越少，越來越少。曹操的人離劉備越來越近，越來越近。七天以後，劉備沒有路了，張飛和趙雲也都累了，每個人都跑不動了。曹操的軍隊就在後面，大聲叫著要來殺劉備。
    就在這時候，路邊的樹和草裡突然沖出來另一隊人馬，有一萬多人。
    最前面的那個人騎著大馬，手拿大刀，他對曹操的兵大聲說：“我在這兒等你們很久了！過來吧，讓我殺了你們！”
    曹操的兵害怕極了，這個人他們都認識，是關羽啊！以前關羽在曹操這兒的時候，大家都見過關羽，也知道關羽有多厲害，誰敢和厲害的關羽打啊？而且現在關羽的後面還有這麼多人的軍隊，就更沒有人敢打了。有人開始往後跑，很快，更多人跟著往後跑。不到一會兒，曹操的兵都跑了。

sentences.simplified: 天亮了。
sentences.traditional: 天亮了。
sentences.pinyin: tiān liàng le
sentences.english: It was dawn.

sentences.simplified: 凡城的城门开了，先走出来的是新也人，然后凡城人也走了出来，
sentences.traditional: 凡城的城門開了，先走出來的是新也人，然後凡城人也走了出來，
sentences.pinyin: fán chéng de chéng mén kāi le xiān zǒu chū lái de shì xīn yě rén rán hòu fán chéng rén yě zǒu le chū lái
sentences.english: The city gates of Fancheng opened. First, the people of Xinye came out, and then the people of Fancheng came out.

sentences.simplified: 最后是刘备和他的军队。
sentences.traditional: 最後是劉備和他的軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu shì liú bèi hé tā de jūn duì
sentences.english: Liu Bei and his troops were last.

sentences.simplified: 新也人和凡城人都不太相信曹操，他们选择跟刘备一起离开凡城。
sentences.traditional: 新也人和凡城人都不太相信曹操，他們選擇跟劉備一起離開凡城。
sentences.pinyin: xīn yě rén hé fán chéng rén dōu bú tài xiāng xìn cáo cāo tā men xuǎn zé gēn liú bèi yì qǐ lí kāi fán chéng
sentences.english: The people of Xinye and Fancheng didn’t really trust Cao Cao, so they chose to leave Fancheng with Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 两天后，曹操的军队杀到了。空城，又是空城！
sentences.traditional: 兩天後，曹操的軍隊殺到了。空城，又是空城！
sentences.pinyin: liǎng tiān hòu cáo cāo de jūn duì shā dào le kōng chéng yòu shì kōng chéng
sentences.english: Two days later, Cao Cao’s army attacked. An abandoned city, another abandoned city!

sentences.simplified: 曹操生气极了，他为不投降的刘备生气，也为新也和凡城人生气！
sentences.traditional: 曹操生氣極了，他為不投降的劉備生氣，也為新也和凡城人生氣！
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shēng qì jí le tā wèi bù tóu xiáng de liú bèi shēng qì yě wèi xīn yě hé fán chéng rén shēng qì
sentences.english: Cao Cao was extremely angry. He was angry that Liu Bei wouldn’t surrender and angry about the people of Xinye and Fancheng!

sentences.simplified: 他不让军队休息，让他们一直找刘备。这一次，他一定要杀了刘备。
sentences.traditional: 他不讓軍隊休息，讓他們一直找劉備。這一次，他一定要殺了劉備。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú ràng jūn duì xiū xi ràng tā men yì zhí zhǎo liú bèi zhè yí cì tā yí dìng yào shā le liú bèi
sentences.english: He didn’t allow his troops to rest and told them to keep looking for Liu Bei. This time, he must kill Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 几天以后，曹操终于找到了刘备。
sentences.traditional: 幾天以後，曹操終於找到了劉備。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ tiān yǐ hòu cáo cāo zhōng yú zhǎo dào le liú bèi
sentences.english: A few days later, Cao Cao finally found Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 曹操看了刘备和他的军队，也看到了走在军队中间的新也和凡城人。
sentences.traditional: 曹操看了劉備和他的軍隊，也看到了走在軍隊中間的新也和凡城人。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo kàn le liú bèi hé tā de jūn duì yě kàn dào le zǒu zài jūn duì zhōng jiān de xīn yě hé fán chéng rén
sentences.english: Cao Cao saw Liu Bei and his troops, and he also saw the people of Xinye and Fancheng walking with the troops.

sentences.simplified: 曹操觉得有些好笑，刘备是个聪明人，但爱做不聪明的事。
sentences.traditional: 曹操覺得有些好笑，劉備是個聰明人，但愛做不聰明的事。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo jué de yǒu xiē hǎo xiào liú bèi shì ge cōng ming rén dàn ài zuò bù cōng ming de shì
sentences.english: Cao Cao thought it was quite funny. Liu Bei was an intelligent person, but he loved doing stupid things.

sentences.simplified: 自己都不能保护的人，要怎么保护别人呢？
sentences.traditional: 自己都不能保護的人，要怎麼保護別人呢？
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ dōu bù néng bǎo hù de rén yào zěn me bǎo hù bié ren ne
sentences.english: How could the people that he was unable to protect now protect others?

sentences.simplified: “杀！”曹操大声说。
sentences.traditional: “殺！”曹操大聲說。
sentences.pinyin: shā cáo cāo dà shēng shuō
sentences.english: “Attack!” Cao Cao said loudly.

sentences.simplified: 大战开始了，但是两边的人都不少，
sentences.traditional: 大戰開始了，但是兩邊的人都不少，
sentences.pinyin: dà zhàn kāi shǐ le dàn shì liǎng biān de rén dōu bù shǎo
sentences.english: A major battle started, but there were many people on both sides.

sentences.simplified: 而且是在山里，树和草太多，路太小，仗打了很多天。
sentences.traditional: 而且是在山裡，樹和草太多，路太小，仗打了很多天。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě shì zài shān lǐ shù hé cǎo tài duō lù tài xiǎo zhàng dǎ le hěn duō tiān
sentences.english: Also, it was on a mountain with many trees and a lot of grass as well as narrow paths. The battle went on for many days.

sentences.simplified: 刘备和军队在跑，新也和凡城人也在跑，
sentences.traditional: 劉備和軍隊在跑，新也和凡城人也在跑，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi hé jūn duì zài pǎo xīn yě hé fán chéng rén yě zài pǎo
sentences.english: Liu Bei and his troops were fleeing, and the people of Xinye and Fancheng were also fleeing.

sentences.simplified: 往山上跑，往河里跑，往树和草里跑……哪儿有路，就往哪儿跑。
sentences.traditional: 往山上跑，往河裡跑，往樹和草裡跑……哪兒有路，就往哪兒跑。
sentences.pinyin: wǎng shān shang pǎo wǎng hé lǐ pǎo wǎng shù hé cǎo lǐ pǎo nǎ'r yǒu lù jiù wǎng nǎ'r pǎo
sentences.english: Up the mountain, toward the river, into the trees and grass … wherever there was a path, they ran.

sentences.simplified: 刘备的人越来越少，越来越少。曹操的人离刘备越来越近，越来越近。
sentences.traditional: 劉備的人越來越少，越來越少。曹操的人離劉備越來越近，越來越近。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo yuè lái yuè shǎo cáo cāo de rén lí liú bèi yuè lái yuè jìn yuè lái yuè jìn
sentences.english: Liu Bei had fewer and fewer men. Cao Cao’s men were getting closer and closer to Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 七天以后，刘备没有路了，张飞和赵云也都累了，每个人都跑不动了。
sentences.traditional: 七天以後，劉備沒有路了，張飛和趙雲也都累了，每個人都跑不動了。
sentences.pinyin: qī tiān yǐ hòu liú bèi méi yǒu lù le zhāng fēi hé zhào yún yě dōu lèi le měi ge rén dōu pǎo bú dòng le
sentences.english: Seven days later, Liu Bei had nowhere left to run. Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun were also tired. None of them could run any longer.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的军队就在后面，大声叫着要来杀刘备。
sentences.traditional: 曹操的軍隊就在後面，大聲叫著要來殺劉備。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de jūn duì jiù zài hòu miàn dà shēng jiào zhe yào lái shā liú bèi
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s men were right behind, loudly shouting to kill Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 就在这时候，路边的树和草里突然冲出来另一队人马，有一万多人。
sentences.traditional: 就在這時候，路邊的樹和草裡突然沖出來另一隊人馬，有一萬多人。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí hou lù biān de shù hé cǎo lǐ tū rán chōng chū lái lìng yí duì rén mǎ yǒu yí wàn duō rén
sentences.english: Just at this time, men and horses rushed out from the trees and grass beside the road. There were more than 10,000 men.

sentences.simplified: 最前面的那个人骑着大马，手拿大刀，
sentences.traditional: 最前面的那個人騎著大馬，手拿大刀，
sentences.pinyin: zuì qián miàn de nà ge rén qí zhe dà mǎ shǒu ná dà dāo
sentences.english: The man at the front rode a big horse and held a big sword in his hand.

sentences.simplified: 他对曹操的兵大声说：“我在这儿等你们很久了！过来吧，让我杀了你们！”
sentences.traditional: 他對曹操的兵大聲說：“我在這兒等你們很久了！過來吧，讓我殺了你們！”
sentences.pinyin: tā duì cáo cāo de bīng dà shēng shuō wǒ zài zhè‘r děng nǐ men hěn jiǔ le guò lái ba ràng wǒ shā le nǐ men
sentences.english: He said loudly to Cao Cao’s soldiers, “I have been here waiting for you for a very long time! Come, let me kill you all!”

sentences.simplified: 曹操的兵害怕极了，这个人他们都认识，是关羽啊！
sentences.traditional: 曹操的兵害怕極了，這個人他們都認識，是關羽啊！
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de bīng hài pà jí le zhè ge rén tā men dōu rèn shi shì guān yǔ a
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s soldiers were very scared. They all knew this person. It was Guan Yu!

sentences.simplified: 以前关羽在曹操这儿的时候，大家都见过关羽，也知道关羽有多厉害，
sentences.traditional: 以前關羽在曹操這兒的時候，大家都見過關羽，也知道關羽有多厲害，
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián guān yǔ zài cáo cāo zhè‘r de shí hou dà jiā dōu jiàn guò guān yǔ yě zhī dào guān yǔ yǒu duō lì hai
sentences.english: Previously when Guan Yu was on Cao Cao’s side, everyone had seen him and knew how formidable he was.

sentences.simplified: 谁敢和厉害的关羽打啊？
sentences.traditional: 誰敢和厲害的關羽打啊？
sentences.pinyin: shéi gǎn hé lì hai de guān yǔ dǎ a
sentences.english: Who dared to fight the formidable Guan Yu?

sentences.simplified: 而且现在关羽的后面还有这么多人的军队，就更没有人敢打了。
sentences.traditional: 而且現在關羽的後面還有這麼多人的軍隊，就更沒有人敢打了。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě xiàn zài guān yǔ de hòu miàn hái yǒu zhè me duō rén de jūn duì jiù gèng méi yǒu rén gǎn dǎ le
sentences.english: Also, there were many troops behind Guan Yu right now. Nobody dared to fight them.

sentences.simplified: 有人开始往后跑，很快，更多人跟着往后跑。
sentences.traditional: 有人開始往後跑，很快，更多人跟著往後跑。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén kāi shǐ wǎng hòu pǎo hěn kuài gèng duō rén gēn zhe wǎng hòu pǎo
sentences.english: People started turning to run away. Very quickly, more people also turned to run away.

sentences.simplified: 不到一会儿，曹操的兵都跑了。
sentences.traditional: 不到一會兒，曹操的兵都跑了。
sentences.pinyin: bú dào yí huì'r cáo cāo de bīng dōu pǎo le
sentences.english: Not long after, Cao Cao’s soldiers had all fled.

sentence_translations: Chapter 9: The Formidable Guan Yu
It was dawn.
The city gates of Fancheng opened. First, the people of Xinye came out, and then the people of Fancheng came out.
Liu Bei and his troops were last.
The people of Xinye and Fancheng didn’t really trust Cao Cao, so they chose to leave Fancheng with Liu Bei.
Two days later, Cao Cao’s army attacked. An abandoned city, another abandoned city!
Cao Cao was extremely angry. He was angry that Liu Bei wouldn’t surrender and angry about the people of Xinye and Fancheng!
He didn’t allow his troops to rest and told them to keep looking for Liu Bei. This time, he must kill Liu Bei.
A few days later, Cao Cao finally found Liu Bei.
Cao Cao saw Liu Bei and his troops, and he also saw the people of Xinye and Fancheng walking with the troops.
Cao Cao thought it was quite funny. Liu Bei was an intelligent person, but he loved doing stupid things.
How could the people that he was unable to protect now protect others?
“Attack!” Cao Cao said loudly.
A major battle started, but there were many people on both sides.
Also, it was on a mountain with many trees and a lot of grass as well as narrow paths. The battle went on for many days.
Liu Bei and his troops were fleeing, and the people of Xinye and Fancheng were also fleeing.
Up the mountain, toward the river, into the trees and grass … wherever there was a path, they ran.
Liu Bei had fewer and fewer men. Cao Cao’s men were getting closer and closer to Liu Bei.
Seven days later, Liu Bei had nowhere left to run. Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun were also tired. None of them could run any longer.
Cao Cao’s men were right behind, loudly shouting to kill Liu Bei.
Just at this time, men and horses rushed out from the trees and grass beside the road. There were more than 10,000 men.
The man at the front rode a big horse and held a big sword in his hand.
He said loudly to Cao Cao’s soldiers, “I have been here waiting for you for a very long time! Come, let me kill you all!”
Cao Cao’s soldiers were very scared. They all knew this person. It was Guan Yu!
Previously when Guan Yu was on Cao Cao’s side, everyone had seen him and knew how formidable he was.
Who dared to fight the formidable Guan Yu?
Also, there were many troops behind Guan Yu right now. Nobody dared to fight them.
People started turning to run away. Very quickly, more people also turned to run away.
Not long after, Cao Cao’s soldiers had all fled.
